name: Shellycoat

attributes.attribute: hid under a coat of shells
weak and powerless without his coat

sources: Spence, Lewis. The Minor Traditions of British Mythology. (New York: Benjamin Blom, Inc., 1972), 18.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Shellycoat is a Scottish monster. This huge water beast lived in the port of Edinburgh. When sailors tried to pass out to sea, he hid under a coat of shells. He tormented them from under that cover. When still and not at his work, he left the coat beneath a rock. Without it he was weak and open to attack. The power lay in the shells. Once the coat left his back, the terror left with it. He could do no harm until he gathered the shell coat again. The tale keeps the old fear of hidden force in the seaward city.
